messages:
jess: Heads up team — Nebula (enterprise POC) wants a mixed-GPU dedicated commit for 90 days: 6x A100 baseline with optional H100 burst capacity for a 14-day performance window. They asked for three special terms: 1) 35% credit on month 1 invoice, 2) ability to convert unused H100 burst hours into a credit applied if they later sign a 12-month commit (no cash refund), and 3) waive the surge multiplier during the 14-day window. Can we get deal-desk + finance review?
tom: Quick context — Nebula is running latency-sensitive models that benefit from H100s for short evaluation. They want predictable cost during the perf window so procurement will sign off. Likely to convert to a longer commit if perf checks.
priya: From solutions: technically feasible. We can gate H100 access by job label and region. Suggest limiting H100 bursts to specific instance families and enforcing a 48h canary before ramp. Also we should limit swapping to a max hours cap so we don't create cashflow surprises.
ethan: Finance: baseline approvals: discounts up to 30% standard; anything above needs deal-desk + revenue ops sign-off. Conversion credits are ok if non-refundable and timeboxed. Need an estimate of expected GPU-hour consumption and model token rates to compute net ARR impact.
deal-desk-bot: @channel Please open a deal-desk ticket with full terms. Example command: 
```
/deal-desk create --customer Nebula --commit "6x A100 for 90d" --burst "up to 6x H100 for 14d" --discount "35% month1" --conversion-credit "max 400 H100-hours" --surcharge-waive yes
```
jess: I'm adding the PSR and expected ARR into the ticket. My suggested guardrails: conversion credit capped at 400 H100-hours, credit expires 90 days after POC or is applied only if a 12-month commit is signed within 60 days.
priya: Draft contract terms to paste into ticket:
```
- Baseline: 6x A100 reserved for a 90-day POC period.
- Burst: Access to up to 6x H100 for a single 14-day performance window during the POC.
- Discount: 35% credit applied to month 1 invoice for baseline commit only.
- Conversion Credit: Unused H100 hours (up to 400 H100-hours) may be converted to account credit applied to the first invoice of a subsequent 12-month Dedicated commitment if executed within 60 days of POC completion. No cash refunds.
- Surge Multiplier: Waived for the 14-day performance window only. Standard surge rates apply outside that window.
- Autoscale/Canary: Burst must be started with a 48-hour canary ramp. Region-locked to us-west-2.
- Billing: any burst consumption exceeding 400 H100-hours billed at standard burst rate.
```
ethan: Looks good. Please add a clause: "If conversion credit applied, credit calculation uses standard burst rate at time of POC (no retroactive re-pricing)." Also need legal to confirm wording around credit expiration and transferability.
jess: Nebula requested that the conversion credit be transferable to another account within their org. Legal flagged transferability as a risk; prefer to keep credits non-transferable. I'll counter with 'transferable within parent org with approval'.
deal-desk-bot: @ethan Confirm: discounts >30% or any conversion-credit exceptions require Deal Desk approval + Revenue Ops sign-off. Tag @revenue-ops when submitting.
ethan: Confirmed. I can provisionally approve a 33% discount with finance lead sign-off; full 35% needs deal-desk + rev-ops.
tom: I'll file ticket now with the proposed terms and request the exception for 35%. Include predicted GPU-hour profile and model family so finance can run numbers.
priya: I'll prepare the canary runbook and metrics list (p95 latency, p99 tail, GPU mem, OOMs, queue time). Also coordinate eng-run so we don't overlap with other scheduled bursts.
jess: Filed: /deal-desk/1845123456 — includes PSR, expected ARR, model family, and ask for 35% exception + conversion-credit up to 400 H100-hours. Tagging @ethan @priya.
deal-desk-bot reaction: :white_check_mark: 
tom: Keeping this thread for updates. Once deal-desk signs off we'll kick legal and ops to finalize SOW and schedule the canary window. :thumbsup:
